verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.wandb.ai/llms.txt and markdown versions of doc pages (e.g., weave.md) that point agents to a full documentation index. First-party docs also describe the W&B MCP Server giving agents direct access to the documentation, and Skills covering the Weave SDK. Missing for 10: the llms.txt is a CoreWeave-wide index rather than a Weave-specific one, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs effectively.
